The through-line

Everything here has a surface — and something underneath it.

One half of this catalogue is the Library: field guides that take the same pattern of psychological manipulation and follow it up through every scale of life — a playground, a festival, a marriage, a sanctuary, an institution, an entire economy. The promise is simple. A pattern you can see is a pattern you can exit.

The other half is the Workshop: hand-poured pendants and hand-pressed wax seals with a near-field core sealed inside. They look like one thing in the open and become another the moment a phone touches them — a song, a voice, a tribute, a secret. Tap to reveal.

Two crafts, one instinct: what matters is usually the thing you can't see yet.

The Instruments

Tools you return to

Living apps, not one-time reads · free, no account · nothing leaves your phone

01TOOL 01

Pattern Decoder

349 tactics, mapped, scored, and searchable

Truth vs. gaslighting, named on sight.

The full manipulation-and-propaganda compendium, rebuilt as a living decoder instead of a book you read once. Search by category or by what you're feeling, trace how tactics cluster and escalate across a constellation map, or hold what you're facing up against verifiable logic and objective reality. Same free, no-account design as the Library — built to open again the next time something feels off.

  • 349 tactics
  • Constellation map
  • Free

02TOOL 02

The Root

A guided shadow-work practice

A reaction is a door, not a flaw.

A guided descent from whatever charge you're carrying — anger, envy, shame — down through the belief that made it necessary, to the protective part that's been running the show, and back up into the light with one small thing to test. Rooted in Jungian shadow work: the parts you exiled to survive aren't disorders, they're evidence you're intelligent. A ten-minute Root, a three-minute check-in, or a follow-up — your words, saved only on your own phone.

  • Shadow work
  • Local & private
  • Free

The Library

Field guides to seeing the pattern

Single-file interactive books · read free on any phone · no app, no account

IVOL. I

The Sovereign Divine Feminine

A field guide to reclaiming your mind.

Forty-two chapters naming psychological manipulation tactic by tactic — each with counter-moves, identity repair, and nervous-system tools. Built on the SOVEREIGN walk: spot, orient, validate, establish, respond, invest, ground, navigate. For anyone told they were "too much" and made to shrink.

  • 42 chapters
  • Counter-moves
  • Free
Open the book→
IIVOL. II

Playground Protectors

Tricky people, power-ups & real friendships.

The same map of manipulation, rewritten in game language for children. Tricky people, power-ups, and how to spot a "friendship" that's really a trap — taught gently, so a kid learns to trust their own gut early. Made for my daughter, and shared with yours.

  • For children
  • Game language
  • Free
Open the book→
IIIVOL. III

The Festie Codex

Spotting wooks in sheep's clothing.

Festival culture is one of the last places adults can lose themselves in real community — and some people have learned to open that door professionally. Twenty-six chapters of harm reduction, consent, and word-for-word counter-moves, written in the language of the lot. Know the pattern. Trust your body. Protect the magic.

  • 26 chapters
  • Harm reduction
  • + Archive
Open the book→
IVVOL. IV

The Fractal

It was never about one person.

Narcissistic abuse doesn't stop at the edge of a relationship — it scales. Thirty manipulation techniques mapped across thirty sectors at three altitudes, from a kitchen table to a civilization, all running the same eight-stage cycle. Read the spectrum once; recognize it everywhere.

  • 30 sectors
  • 8-stage cycle
  • 40+ hr series
Open the book→
VVOL. V

The Fracture Everywhere

Fifty trillion dollars. Where did it go?

A documented wealth transfer, traced episode by episode — every name, every pipeline, every self-sustaining loop, and how the architecture ends up living in your own body. The reading edition, with 195 sourced references and a companion story for one ordinary Tuesday.

  • 12 episodes
  • 195 citations
  • Free
Open the book→
VIVOL. VI

The Sacred Divide

Your faith is yours. The machinery is not.

Twenty-five traditions, examined the same way — not the belief, only the architecture built around it. An ordinary day in a believer's life, then the dated moment the tradition gained the power to compel, the offices and named holders who receive the money, the eight-stage cycle with all thirty tactics inside it, and the questions you are entitled to ask out loud. No page tells you to leave. Every page assumes you might stay.

  • 25 traditions
  • 750 entries
  • 6-min or full read
Open the book→
VIIVOL. VII

The Loop

The machine that learns you.

Forty-seven chapters on the algorithmic instrument nobody designed — the same optimisation that runs your feed also schedules your shifts, prices your groceries, and ranks your dates. Named machinery instead of vague dread, and a counter-movement that starts from admitting you cannot out-willpower an optimiser.

  • 47 chapters
  • No tracking
  • Free
Open the book→
VIIIVOL. VIII

The Weighing

How to be right about people.

Thirty-eight chapters on calibrating judgment — when to trust the signal and when it is your own history talking, the seven tests that actually discriminate manipulation from ordinary human failure, and the discipline of being wrong well. Written for the reader as carefully as for whoever they are trying to read.

  • 38 chapters
  • 7 tests
  • Free

The Collection

All eight, free at the gate.

Read them in any order.

Each book is one entry point into the same idea, sized for a different life — the playground, the lot, the relationship, the institution, the economy, the sanctuary, the feed, the judgment call. Start where your own situation lives, and the rest will rhyme. Most remember where you stopped. Two keep no record at all, on purpose — and say why inside. The Workshop

Objects with a living core

01PIECE 01

The Portals

Hand-poured resin pendants · one of one, never repeated

Worn in the light. Alive in the dark.

A painting in glass by day. A strontium core that ignites and glows from the inside for hours by night. And a reprogrammable NFC chip cured into the resin that you tap to open anything — a business card, a song, a tribute, a treasure hunt. One object, three lives, and it changes whenever you do.

  • Strontium glow
  • 100,000 rewrites
  • No battery
Enter the Portal index→
02PIECE 02

The Press

Real wax seals · pressed by hand, the way kings did

Sealed by kings. Opened by a tap.

A real wax seal — your design, pressed by hand the way it's been done for a thousand years — with a living core inside. Press a phone to the wax and it plays what you chose: a voice, a song, a short film, or a letter locked until a date only you set. For weddings, memorials, and everything that deserves more than a card.

  • Voice inside

The Maker

Shae Stovell, working as Noble Father Creations.

One person, two crafts. On one side, field guides that teach people to see psychological manipulation — at every scale, from a child's playground to a fifty-trillion-dollar economy. On the other, hand-made NFC objects that carry a hidden, take-everywhere piece of someone's world inside resin and wax.

The books are written to a single standard — unvarnished, sovereignty-centred, and built to be read on the worst night of someone's life. They are free. Read them, share them, hand them to whoever needs them. No paywall, no account.

A pattern you can see is a pattern you can exit.
